target.title: fix: shell cron reminders still show unscheduled note
target.body:
﻿Closes #52972

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who scheduled a one-time reminder through a successful shell command such as `openclaw cron add --at ...` could still receive the contradictory "I did not schedule a reminder" note in the same reply.

## Why This Change Was Made

The reminder guard already trusts structured cron-tool successes, but shell-driven cron adds pass through the exec/bash tool path. This change records successful shell `openclaw cron add --at` commands at the tool-result producer boundary using parsed command arguments and the exec completion status, without matching prose output or broad cron commands.

This follow-up merges latest `upstream/main` into the branch so stale base failures in unrelated `packages/gateway-protocol` and Android native i18n inventory are no longer part of this PR's current-head CI.

## User Impact

Users can schedule reminders through shell-based cron commands without seeing a false failure note after the cron job was created. Failed commands, unrelated cron commands, and non-reminder cron adds remain uncounted.

## Evidence

- Current head: `9c3f524e37415f655bbd0742196b8fb86b981c3b`.
- Claim proved: successful `exec`/`bash` shell `openclaw cron add --at` commands increment `successfulCronAdds`, while failed shell commands, `cron list`, and cron adds without `--at` do not. The terminal reply guard consumes `successfulCronAdds: 1` and returns no incomplete-turn warning payload, which prevents the contradictory unscheduled-reminder note path from firing after committed cron progress.
- Commands:
  - `git diff --check` - passed.
  - `PNPM_CONFIG_MODULES_DIR="E:\code\openclaw\node_modules" node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts` - passed: 1 file, 86 tests.
  - `PNPM_CONFIG_MODULES_DIR="E:\code\openclaw\node_modules" node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.incomplete-turn.test.ts` - passed: 1 file, 114 tests.
- Current-head CI after merging latest `main`:
  - `check-prod-types` passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28792414999/job/85374290527
  - `check-lint` passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28792414999/job/85374290521
  - `check-test-types` passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28792414999/job/85374290502
  - `checks-node-compact-small-whole-2` passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28792414999/job/85374290855
- Observed result: the previous stale-base `gateway-protocol` unused-import and Android native i18n drift failures are gone on the current head. The focused producer and reply-guard tests cover the shell cron add success signal and the guard that suppresses the contradictory terminal note.

Not tested / proof gaps:
- No live Telegram Desktop/Mantis reminder turn was run in this follow-up; that proof path needs the external desktop/channel environment. The current proof exercises the shell tool-result producer and the terminal reply guard that consumes `successfulCronAdds`.
